docs.title: Welcome!
docs.text:
I am an electrical engineer based in the Chicagoland area of Illinois. Welcome to my personal website.

Here you can find my resume and some information about my personal projects. My projects consist of a mix of radio frequency (RF) systems and power systems simulations and computational tools, as I had my start in RF but more recently I am becoming more involved in the power world.

The future is bright! Let's get to work...
